title: Wren and Rook Brand Guidelines
summary: A distinctive brand identity crafted for Wren & Rook, a board game café where exceptional coffee, quality food, and a curated library of games create a welcoming social experience. The visual system blends warmth, wit, and understated character, capturing a clever yet relaxed atmosphere that invites guests to stay, connect, and play without limits.
intent: Warmth and wit for a board-game cafe built for staying put.
